newsitem.title: USA: Market Guide to put database on-line.
newsitem.headline: Market Guide to put database on-line.

text.p: Market Guide Inc said on Wednesday that it had signed a multi-year contract with Reality Online Inc, a Reuters Holdings Plc company.

It said the contract will give Reality the right to distribute its company profile reports as part of the Reuters Money Network, which it also distributes. Reality will also distribute its profile reports on its Internet site.
Market Guide, which compiles financial databases, said it will create additional customized reports for Reality to distribute in the future.
Reality offers on-line services and technology for brokerage firms, mutual funds and banks.
